tasks.short: Maintain specialist expertise in collection materials

steps.what: Specialize in particular materials through close examination, practical learning and expert consultation

tasks.design: Retain material expertise and practical learning with the conservator, using {DOCS} for reference notes. Searchable material does not replace examining an object or learning its behaviour.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specialist understanding depends on experience with variable materials.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing references and expert consultation support continuing learning.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing unusual deterioration and limits of general guidance.
tasks.human_edge: The conservator notices when an object differs from the expected pattern.

reach.learn: Connect material evidence to object history

evidence.claim: Retaining material expertise as human work is an E1 design; no measured replacement capability is supplied.

assumptions: The baseline is developing and applying expertise, not a separately measured transcription operation.
The conservator obtains observations and expert explanations within s1; all time remains counted.
Existing DOCS references precede a new assistant.
No new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which recurring reference access problems can be separated from practical learning?

already_counted.description: Object examination, learning and expert consultation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100; gross and net saving zero. No separate repetitive component is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend preservation procedures to collection and building staff

steps.what: Recommend preservation procedures after assessing objects, environmental conditions and building constraints

tasks.design: Keep preservation recommendations with the conservator, recording rationale in {DOCS}. Environmental monitoring is supporting evidence; choosing suitable conditions and agreeing feasible procedures remain human work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Object needs and building constraints may conflict.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing environmental evidence can inform advice without determining it.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting justified conditions and resolving mixed-material trade-offs.
tasks.human_edge: The conservator explains uncertainty and negotiates practical protections with staff.

reach.learn: Understand plant limitations and environmental variability

evidence.claim: Hanwell climate sensors and alarms are used at the Mary Rose; that supports environmental monitoring capability, not automated preservation recommendations.

assumptions: This task provides advice rather than installing sensors or continuously monitoring climate.
The conservator gathers condition evidence and staff explanations during s1; all time remains counted, with no free preservation-suitability flag.
Existing DOCS and environmental records precede new tools.
No new monitoring system or incremental upkeep is introduced by this recommendation design.
unknowns: Collection materials and available environmental evidence
research_questions: Which environmental constraints most often prevent staff from following preservation advice?

already_counted.description: Evidence review, judgment and discussion with staff

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving. Sensor capability does not establish advice labour reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test objects to establish conservation requirements

steps.what: Perform tests and examinations and establish storage and conservation requirements from findings

tasks.design: Retain object examination, testing and requirement selection with the conservator, using {DOCS} for working evidence. Report drafting belongs to the separate laboratory reporting task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements depend on physical evidence and the limits of individual tests.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing examination methods support documented professional judgment.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting incomplete findings while avoiding unnecessary damage to objects.
tasks.human_edge: The conservator chooses proportionate tests and recognizes their limitations.

reach.learn: Distinguish analytical observations from treatment implications

evidence.claim: Manual examination and conservation requirements are an E1 proposal; the digest establishes no measured replacement.

assumptions: This baseline includes testing and interpretation rather than the final report preparation assigned separately.
The conservator produces findings and requirement judgments within s1, retaining all capture and examination time.
Existing test methods and DOCS suffice before a new application.
No new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which measurements have a repeatable numerical calculation distinct from physical examination?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100; gross and net saving zero. Separate report drafting is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report conservation laboratory work and treatment evidence

steps.what: Capture artifact condition, treatment options and methods for laboratory reports
Draft reports documenting conservation operations from the verified packet

loop.purpose: Organize recorded conservation facts into a report
loop.input: Verified report packet with source references
loop.output: Draft separating observations, options and work actually performed
loop.check: Resolve object identifiers and have the conservator compare every condition and treatment statement with the source record
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing evidence requires manual text and remains explicitly unknown
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle headings and repeated fields but varied narrative needs language organization

steps.what: Verify conservation reports and save the final laboratory record

tasks.design: Use controlled {DOCS} templates and a bounded assistant for report prose after the conservator prepares verified source material. The conservator checks that options remain distinct from completed treatment and saves the final record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly organizing treatment notes into report narrative.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting from selected evidence can reduce prose preparation without replacing conservation judgment.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible sentence can falsely imply a treatment was performed or a condition was confirmed.
tasks.human_edge: The conservator knows what was observed, proposed and actually done.

reach.learn: Keep source references and distinguish observation from inference

evidence.claim: A bounded conservation-report drafting workflow is an E1 design; no named conservation reporting product case is established by the digest.

assumptions: Only report preparation changes; examination, testing and treatment remain outside the saving.

In s1 the conservator produces object identifier, dated condition observations, source references, treatment options and completed-method records; 35 hours include source selection, capture and correction. Missing evidence forces manual drafting.
Native document templates and reusable approved wording precede model prose.
No object condition, treatment suitability or completion flag is generated from unsupported text.
research_questions: Can checked drafts reduce report time without mixing options, observations and completed treatments?

already_counted.description: Report source capture, draft checking and final verification

incremental.description: Maintain templates and audit treatment-statement accuracy

approvals.approved_version: Exact report text, object references and treatment status; changes require conservator review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=91.25 gives 8.75 gross less 5 focal upkeep =3.75 central net. Report 0-1 until reports are timed; weak source notes may require complete manual rewriting.

reach: Work with building managers on feasible preservation conditions
role.ambitious_version: A conservator who reduces repetitive report prose while retaining practical examination and preservation judgment
